prompt:
Designed website UI screenshot of the rest2mcp marketing homepage first viewport, desktop landscape 1440 by 900, full-width site chrome on a flat Paper #FFFFFF ground. This is a real product webpage layout, not a poster, not a photograph, not a 3D scene.

REGIONS in order, with scale:

1) NAV (full width, thin, ~56px): left-aligned official rest2mcp wordmark copied from the reference lockup — lowercase rest and mcp in Ink #0B0B0B custom stencil lettering, only the 2 in Gate Orange #FD410B, same stencil cuts and proportions as the reference PNG. Right: small Inter Medium “Log in” in Ink. No extra nav items, no hamburger.

2) LEFT COLUMN (~32% width, from nav to bottom): a dense noisy REST catalog. Dozens of endpoint rows in system monospace, light gray (#A3A3A3 / #C4C4C4), tight leading, reading as inventory noise not a terminal: GET /v1/users, POST /v1/users, GET /v1/users/{id}, PUT /v1/users/{id}, DELETE /v1/users/{id}, GET /v1/users/{id}/settings, PATCH /v1/settings, GET /v1/invoices, GET /v1/invoices/{id}, POST /v1/invoices, POST /v1/invoices/{id}/void, GET /v1/invoices/{id}/lines, GET /v1/orders, GET /v1/orders/{id}, POST /v1/orders, PATCH /v1/orders/{id}, DELETE /v1/orders/{id}, GET /v1/orders/{id}/items, POST /v1/orders/{id}/cancel, GET /v1/webhooks, POST /v1/webhooks, DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id}, GET /v1/events, POST /v1/events/{id}/replay, GET /v1/keys, DELETE /v1/keys/{id}, GET /health, GET /metrics, GET /admin/audit, GET /v1/refunds, POST /v1/refunds. The column is wide and crowded. It is physically cut off by the left silhouette of the center 2; gray paths do not continue through the numeral.

3) CENTER (~36% width, dominant): a very large custom stencil numeral 2 occupying the middle of the viewport, taller than both columns, the same constructed stencil geometry as the reference wordmark 2 (two horizontal stencil slots, geometric bars, open counters, no serifs). Solid flat Gate Orange #FD410B only. This 2 is a functional gate and cut, not a mascot: its left edge shears the REST list; its stencil openings and counter are Paper-colored holes, a literal opening. No glow, no drop shadow, no outline, no 3D bevel, no rotation. Instrument of oficio — a working stencil used as a gate.

4) RIGHT COLUMN (~28% width): six kept MCP tools that passed the gate, in full Ink #0B0B0B, system mono, generous line spacing, aligned with the 2’s openings as if they came through the cut: getCustomer, listInvoices, getInvoice, searchOrders, getOrder, listPayments. At the 2’s main horizontal stencil opening sits a compact Inter Medium “Sign up” control (Ink fill, Paper label, sharp rectangle, no shadow) — the signup is at the opening, the threshold of the gate.

No footer in this first viewport. No testimonials, no prices, no metrics, no dates, no customer logos, no dark terminal, no zinc cards, no gradients, no glass, no glow, no drop shadows. Palette only Paper #FFFFFF, Ink #0B0B0B, Gate Orange #FD410B on the 2 (and the wordmark 2). Inter for UI chrome; system mono for endpoints and tool names. Flat, sharp, print-like website. The reference image is the official wordmark for mark geometry and palette only — do not place the full lockup as a giant hero; the giant center object is the 2 alone as the gate.
